mapper.sql: s.id,s.account_id,s.name,s.capability,s.provider_code,s.endpoint,s.model_id,s.secret_id,s.parameters,s.status,s.revision,s.created_at,s.updated_at, exists(select 1 from p_secret ps where ps.id=s.secret_id and ps.status='ACTIVE') as credential_configured
mapper.select: select count(*) from p_official_service s s.capability=#{capability}and s.status=#{status}
select from p_official_service s where s.id=#{serviceId}
select from p_official_service s where s.id=#{serviceId} for update

select from p_official_service s join p_secret ps on ps.id=s.secret_id and ps.status='ACTIVE' where s.id=#{serviceId} and s.revision=#{expectedRevision} and s.capability=#{capability} and s.status='ACTIVE'
select id,ciphertext,nonce,auth_tag,key_version,algorithm,status from p_secret where id=#{secretId} and status='ACTIVE'
select request_hash,resource_id from p_api_idempotency where account_id=#{accountId} and scope=#{scope} and request_id=#{requestId} for update
select count(*) from p_generation_task where id=#{taskId} and official_service_id=#{serviceId} and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(service_snapshot,'$.revision')) as unsigned)=#{revision}

select count(*) from p_voice_version where id=#{voiceVersionId} and official_service_id=#{serviceId} and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(official_config_snapshot,'$.revision')) as unsigned)=#{revision}
mapper.insert: insert into p_official_service (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,name,capability,provider_code,endpoint,model_id,secret_id,parameters,status,revision) values (#{id},utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{accountId},#{name},#{capability},#{providerCode},#{endpoint},#{modelId},#{secretId},cast(#{parameters} as json),#{status},#{revision})
mapper.update: update p_official_service set name=#{name},capability=#{capability},provider_code=#{providerCode},endpoint=#{endpoint},model_id=#{modelId},secret_id=#{secretId},parameters=cast(#{parameters} as json),status=#{status},revision=#{revision},updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and revision=#{revision}-1
update p_official_service set status=#{status},revision=#{revision},updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{serviceId} and revision=#{revision}-1
